# event boundaries task

## load libs
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
```

## plot settings
```{r}
txt <- element_text(size = 30, family = "Avenir", color = "black")

theme_set(
  theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          text = txt,
          axis.text = txt)
)
```

## load raw data
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
path.data <- file.path("~", "Downloads", "mia3_submissions")

df.eb <- path.data |> 
  list.files(pattern = "*.csv",
             full.names = TRUE) |> 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  filter(trial_index == 7)
```

## extract responses
```{r}
extract_response_timestamps <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    mutate(
      button_times = map(response_times, function(x) {
        if (is.na(x)) return(NULL)
        
        times <- str_remove_all(x, "\\[|\\]") |> 
          str_split(",") |> 
          unlist() |> 
          as.numeric()
        
        return(times)
      })
    ) |> 
    select(subject_id, button_times) |> 
    unnest(button_times) |> 
    mutate(button_times_sec = button_times / 1000)
}
```

## kde estimation per subject
```{r}
kde_per_subj <- function(button_df, bandwidth = 1) {
  max_time <- max(button_df$button_times_sec, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  time_grid <- seq(0, max_time, by = 0.1) # i.e., 0.1s intervals
  
  all_densities <- list()
  
  subjects <- unique(button_df$subject_id)
  
  for (subject in subjects) {
    subj_data <- button_df |> 
      filter(subject_id == subject)
    
    if (nrow(subj_data) > 0) {
      kde <- density(subj_data$button_times_sec,
                     bw = bandwidth,
                     from = 0, to = max_time,
                     n = length(time_grid))
      
      subj_density_df <- data.frame(
        subject_id = subject,
        time = kde$x,
        density = kde$y
      )
      
      all_densities[[subject]] <- subj_density_df
    }
  }
  
  return(bind_rows(all_densities))
}

agg_densities <- function(all_densities_df) {
  # aggregated across all subjects
  agg_density <- all_densities_df |> 
    group_by(time) |> 
    summarize(mean_density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  # normalized aggregated density
  max_density <- max(agg_density$mean_density, na.rm = TRUE)
  agg_density <- agg_density |> 
    mutate(
      normalized_density = mean_density / max_density
    )
  
  # descriptive stats
  mean_density <- mean(agg_density$normalized_density, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_density <- sd(agg_density$normalized_density, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # find peaks in dist above 0.5 threshold
  # i.e., peak if greater than both its neighbors
  agg_density <- agg_density |> 
    mutate(
      is_peak = normalized_density > 0.5 &
                lead(normalized_density, default = 0) < normalized_density &
                lag(normalized_density, default = 0) < normalized_density
    )
  
  event_boundaries <- agg_density |> 
    filter(is_peak) |> 
    select(time, normalized_density)
  
  return(list(
    agg_density = agg_density,
    event_boundaries = event_boundaries,
    mean = mean_density,
    sd = sd_density
  ))
}
```

## run and plot
```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(100)

df.resps <- df.eb |> extract_response_timestamps()
df.all_densities <- df.resps |> drop_na(button_times_sec) |> kde_per_subj()
df.agg_density <- df.all_densities |> agg_densities()

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = df.all_densities,
    aes(x = time, y = density, group = subject_id),
    color = "lightgray", alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df.agg_density$agg_density,
    aes(x = time, y = normalized_density * max(df.all_densities$density)),
    color = "red", size = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = df.agg_density$event_boundaries,
    aes(xintercept = time),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "blue"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = df.agg_density$event_boundaries,
    aes(x = time, y = 0.025, label = paste0(round(time, 1), "s")),
    vjust = -0.25, angle = 90, size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "P45 Spring '25: Students' event segmentation responses",
    subtitle = "Event boundaries (prob > 0.5)",
    x = "Video Time (seconds, out of 5 mins)",
    y = "Density"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path("~", "Downloads", "eb_mia3_results.jpg"),
  width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```
